objective: Gate4E-R2. Comparar la semantica real de vw_RRR_ClienteActividadComercial V2 contra las fuentes y reglas comerciales canonicas existentes. Determinar si V2 puede certificarse o requiere V3. Solo SELECT; sin DDL/DML ni cambios de codigo o Produccion.

queries.name: g4e_r2_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS user_name

queries.name: g4e_r2_venta_estatus_catalog
queries.sql: SELECT EstatusVentaID,Descripcion,Activo FROM dbo.Venta_Estatus ORDER BY EstatusVentaID

queries.name: g4e_r2_venta_distribution_by_status
queries.sql: SELECT v.EstatusVentaID,e.Descripcion,e.Activo,COUNT_BIG(*) AS venta_rows,MIN(v.FechaVenta) AS min_fecha_venta,MAX(v.FechaVenta) AS max_fecha_venta,SUM(v.Total) AS total_importe FROM dbo.Venta_Encabezado v LEFT JOIN dbo.Venta_Estatus e ON e.EstatusVentaID=v.EstatusVentaID GROUP BY v.EstatusVentaID,e.Descripcion,e.Activo ORDER BY v.EstatusVentaID

queries.name: g4e_r2_runtime_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.precision,c.scale,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime') ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: g4e_r2_rrr_eventos_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.RRR_Eventos') ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: g4e_r2_sales_by_client_status
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (100) v.ClienteID,v.EstatusVentaID,e.Descripcion,COUNT_BIG(*) AS venta_rows,SUM(v.Total) AS total_importe,MIN(v.FechaVenta) AS primera_fecha,MAX(v.FechaVenta) AS ultima_fecha FROM dbo.Venta_Encabezado v LEFT JOIN dbo.Venta_Estatus e ON e.EstatusVentaID=v.EstatusVentaID GROUP BY v.ClienteID,v.EstatusVentaID,e.Descripcion ORDER BY venta_rows DESC,v.ClienteID

queries.name: g4e_r2_activity_vs_raw_counts
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.Venta_Encabezado) AS venta_rows,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.Venta_Encabezado WHERE Activo=1) AS venta_rows_activo,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.vw_RRR_ClienteActividadComercial) AS activity_rows,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.Cliente_Catalogo) AS cliente_catalogo_rows

queries.name: g4e_r2_activity_null_cliente
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS activity_null_cliente FROM dbo.vw_RRR_ClienteActividadComercial WHERE ClienteID IS NULL
